name: Economy
description: Managing resources by building workers, expanding to new bases, and scaling production while avoiding oversaturation or resource float.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Army
description: Creating the right units, managing their upgrades, and controlling them effectively in battle (micro and composition).
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Build Orders
description: Executing a planned sequence of actions that reaches specific goals at specific timings, such as unit production, expansion, or tech.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Scouting
description: Gaining and denying information to assess the opponent’s strategy, predict timings, and adapt your own plan accordingly.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Strategy
description: Long-term game planning and decision-making, including how to win given your opponent’s behavior, tech path, or map situation.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Tactics
description: Short-term decisions involving positioning, engagements, harassment, and exploiting terrain to gain advantages in fights.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Map Control
description: Maintaining vision, limiting the opponent’s movement, denying expansions, and safely controlling parts of the map for strategic advantage.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Mechanics
description: Your execution ability: efficient APM, hotkey use, multitasking, avoiding supply blocks, and making fast, accurate inputs under pressure.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Other
description: Anything that doesn't fit into the other categories, such as specific unit interactions, map-specific strategies, or unique game mechanics.
subject: StarCraft 2

name: Laning Phase
description: Covers everything about the early game: wave management (freezing, slow/fast pushing), trading and harassment, positioning, and maintaining lane vision. Strong laning builds the foundation for mid-game success.
subject: League of Legends

name: Macro Play
description: Focuses on map-wide decision-making, rotations, and objective control. Includes understanding win conditions, tempo, pressure, and how to translate small advantages into major map control.
subject: League of Legends

name: Micro Mechanics
description: Individual skill expression—executing champion combos, landing skillshots, kiting/orbwalking, tracking cooldowns, and outplaying opponents through precise mechanics.
subject: League of Legends

name: Itemization
description: Learning when and why to build specific items. Includes core and situational builds, counter-building (anti-heal, armor pen, MR), power spikes, and synergy between mythic and legendary items.
subject: League of Legends

name: Teamfighting
description: Understanding 5v5 engagements—engage/disengage tools, positioning, target priority, ultimate tracking, and how to convert fights into objectives afterward.
subject: League of Legends

name: Map Awareness
description: Developing awareness through vision control, tracking enemy movements, jungle presence, and recognizing rotations. Includes optimal ward placement and reading the minimap effectively.
subject: League of Legends

name: Champion Knowledge
description: Covers matchups, counters, and champion archetypes such as assassins, bruisers, and enchanters. Also includes scaling curves, power spikes, and understanding how kits interact.
subject: League of Legends

name: Drafting & Strategy
description: Long-term planning starting from champ select. Includes composition building, synergy, counterpicks, lane priority, and identifying team win conditions before and during the match.
subject: League of Legends

name: Jungle Pathing & Objectives
description: Mastering early game jungle routes, efficient clears, gank timings, counter-jungling, and objective trades like Dragon, Rift Herald, and Baron control.
subject: League of Legends

name: Mindset & Improvement
description: Building consistency through emotional control and self-reflection. Covers tilt management, communication, learning from losses, and maintaining focus during long play sessions.
subject: League of Legends
